method.interval: Percentile paired bootstrap over projects; variable issue count for issue-weighted estimates.
method.p_value: Two-sided project sign-flip; exact for at most 14 nonzero projects, otherwise Monte Carlo with plus-one correction.
method.holm_family: All 5 comparisons x 2 identity modes x 3 cohort views x 2 estimands (60 tests).
method.deduplication: Keep lexicographically first PR ID per (case-normalized repo, issue) within each matched cohort; outcomes unused.

limitations: Exploratory analysis of exposed results, not preregistered confirmation or an equivalence test.
Intervals are pointwise; sign-flip inference assumes independent projects and exchangeable paired differences under the null.
Oracle headroom sees outcomes and does not establish learnable routing or a cost benefit.
Source snapshot inventories are not in this transferred bundle; their prior audit cannot be independently repeated from it.
